mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, consistently producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20-day horizons without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% (positive return rate <40%).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market slack that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5-day horizons.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (negative return rate <40%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) > 2200 and GDP (GDPC1) > 10000 signal robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60-day horizons.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 2200 and GDPC1 > 10000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 3-month moving average during early-cycle recovery signals accelerating supply capacity, supporting economic growth and corporate profitability for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances during early-cycle recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month average consistently signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, reflecting underlying economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5-day horizons.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 130,000 thousand persons signals a tight labor market that precedes monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 3.0% combined with CPIAUCSL above 192.0 signals active monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 192.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 6-month moving average during late-cycle expansion signals capacity constraints that trigger inflationary pressures and rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5-day horizons.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion regime.
